question: ________ was posthumously conferred the second-highest civilian award in India, the Padma Vibhushan in the field of public affairs in 2023.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mulayam Singh Yadav**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mulayam Singh Yadav** was posthumously conferred the Padma Vibhushan in the field of public affairs in 2023.
 
• The Padma Vibhushan is the second-highest civilian award in India.
 
• Mulayam Singh Yadav was a prominent Indian politician and founder of the Samajwadi Party.
 
• He served as the Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh and held various significant political positions throughout his career.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Padma Vibhushan is awarded for exceptional and distinguished service in any field including service rendered by Government servants.
 
• It was instituted on 2 January 1954 and is awarded by the President of India.
 
• Other notable recipients of the Padma Vibhushan in 2023 include Balkrishna Doshi and Dilip Mahalanabis.
 
• Mulayam Singh Yadav's contribution to Indian politics and his role in shaping the socio-political landscape of Uttar Pradesh are widely recognized.
